_comment: Per-example overrides for fingerprint tolerance and accepted-status. Defaults in generate_fingerprint.py: best_loss abs=1e-6 rel=1e-3; component abs=1e-6 rel=5e-3; hyperparam abs=1e-3 rel=1e-3; evals_tol=0. Override only when justified.

01_baseline_bfgs.description: Single-shot DLIB:BFGS baseline; iter 0 is the implicit CONFIG point (RCUT2B = 5.6).

02_random_seeded.description: INIT { STRATEGY RANDOM, SEED 1234 } — seeded random init chain into DLIB:BFGS.

03_lhs_multistart.description: INIT { STRATEGY LHS } + STRATEGY { TYPE MULTISTART, N_STARTS, BUDGET_PER_START }.

04_sobol_seeded_gfs.description: INIT { STRATEGY SOBOL } seeds DLIB:GFS (which consumes all K seeds).

05_warm_refinement.description: INIT { STRATEGY WARM, WARM_ON_MISMATCH } seeded from HOT_A0 cache.

06_prior_seeded.description: INIT { STRATEGY PRIOR } using descriptor suggested_value.

07_stage_global.description: STRATEGY { TYPE PRESTAGE, TOPK, EXPLORE { ... } } — global pre-stage feeding refine.

08_restart_on_stagnation.description: STRATEGY { RESTART { AFTER_STAGNATION, MAX, STRATEGY } } — relaunch on stagnation.

09_noise_auto_bfgs.description: NOISE { AUTO } bareword — auto FD-step calibration before BFGS.

10_derivative_free_local.description: STRATEGY { TYPE PLAIN, LIB NLOPT, ALGO LN_SBPLX, STEP } — derivative-free local search.

11_chained_init_warm_lhs.description: Chained init: WARM + LHS + DLIB:GFS, WARM-front reorder.

12_random_search.description: STRATEGY { TYPE PLAIN, LIB TADAH, ALGO RANDOM, SEED } — pure random search.

13_nlopt_crs_global.description: LIB NLOPT, ALGO GN_CRS2_LM — pure stochastic global, no internal local refinement.

14_nlopt_mlsl_lds.description: LIB NLOPT, ALGO G_MLSL_LDS + INNER { LIB NLOPT, ALGO LN_BOBYQA } — MLSL global+local hybrid.

15_basins_run_and_forget.description: STRATEGY { TYPE BASINS, EXPLORE { FTOL_LADDER, BUDGET_* }, REFINE { ... } } — anytime BASINS pipeline.
status_accepted: STOPPED — nlopt failure (algorithm converged; consider adding ftol_rel / xtol_rel / maxeval to stop cleanly next time)
15_basins_run_and_forget.tolerance_rationale: BASINS is anytime; final basin pool depends on EXPLORE/REFINE budgets and on a stochastic NLOPT inner. Bit-deterministic when SEED 1717 is set on this machine, but other machines (different LAPACK/BLAS) may explore basins in slightly different order. Loose loss tolerances tolerate that; eval-count window of ±50 absorbs adaptive budget rate.
